The section has no duration or condition, no held instrument amends or revokes it, and the 2025 and 2026 held documents treat the delegation as current.

The words "are hereby superseded" make it a one-time command that operates on issuance, with no later act required, and the order states no effective date later than signing. The superseded orders' rules survive only through section 3, which is a separate continuing clause, and no later instrument is claimed as the end.

reason: Operative on 2026-10-14 as a standing saving clause. Section 3 provides that the rules and regulations contained in the superseded orders, and those issued under their authority, that were in force when the order was issued remain in full force and effect until revoked or amended in pursuance of the authority conferred by this order, "unless sooner terminated by operation of law". The clause has no date or event that ends it; no held instrument revokes or amends it; and the passport rule-making it preserves continues under section 1. No held source identifies an individual saved rule that is still in force or that ended, which is disclosed rather than inferred.
